changelog: Seven new channels from the Backwhen lineup, all in the user-uploaded tier: Swamp TV (ch 217, M*A*S*H 24/7), Mockingbird (ch 218, The Munsters + The Munsters Today), Blue's Clues & Friends (ch 219), Watertower Kids (ch 220, Kids' WB: Animaniacs, Pinky and the Brain, Tiny Toon Adventures), Checkerboard (ch 221, Cartoon Network: Dexter's Laboratory, Powerpuff Girls), Mouse House (ch 222, Disney Afternoon: DuckTales), Moose TV (ch 223, Canadian classics: Fraggle Rock, The Beachcombers). New multi-file catalog support: folders marked multiFile now emit one catalog entry per episode file, so full-series collections on the Archive play as real 24/7 channels instead of a single episode. Star Trek (The Bridge) is not included yet — no clean full-episode MP4 source found on the Archive. Everything else from 0.3.0.6 is unchanged (720p output, Holiday TV, 7 guide themes).
description: Turns the Internet Archive into a retro-video library and live channels inside Jellyfin.
name: Retro TV
overview: Retro TV — Saturday-morning cartoons, classic TV, drive-in movies and more, from the Internet Archive.
